.execute database script <|
.set-or-replace FabrikamCustomers           with (folder = "Bronze")   <| external_table('extFabrikamCustomers')

.set-or-replace FabrikamResellerInventory   with (folder = "Bronze")   <| external_table('extFabrikamResellerInventory')
